conbody.p: If the vehicle is in OFF position with the headlights ON, the headlights remain on for approximately 5 minutes. However, if the driver’s door is opened and closed, the headlights turn off after about 15 seconds.
You can also turn off the headlights by pressing the lock button () on the smart key wice, or by turning the lighting control lever to the OFF position.
Select SettingsVehicleLightsHeadlight Delay on the infotainment system to activated or deactivate headlight escort function.

note.p: The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more information, refer to the manual provided in the infotainment system and the quick reference guide.
